1. (Currently amended) A system for lexical navigation of a corpus of items, comprising: a processor; and a memory, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to: generate a data structure comprising: a plurality of items; a plurality of keywords; and a frequency that each of the plurality of keywords is associated with each of the plurality of items; generate a top-level lexical cloud, comprising a subset of the plurality of keywords selected based on highest frequency of appearance, wherein each keyword in the top-level lexical cloud has an associated size that is proportional to the keyword's frequency of appearance in the data structure; and generate a lower-level lexical cloud by: receiving a user selection of a keyword from the top-level lexical cloud; creating a temporary data structure by removing any items not associated with the selected keyword from the data structure; and generating the lower-level lexical cloud from the temporary data structure, comprising a second subset of the plurality of keywords, wherein each keyword in the second subset has an associated size proportional to its frequency of appearance in the temporary data structure.

2. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to display the top-level lexical cloud and obtain a user selection of a keyword in the top-level lexical cloud.

3. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to display a subset of the plurality of items based, at least in part, on keywords selected from the top-level lexical cloud and at least one lower-level lexical cloud.

4. (Original) The system of claim 1, comprising a storage device that comprises technical documents, patents, Web pages, word processing documents, spreadsheet documents, or any combinations thereof.

5. (Original) The system of claim 4, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to access files stored the storage device and to generate the plurality of keywords from the files.

6. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to determine a number of keywords in the top-level lexical cloud based, at least in part, on a size of a display area and a maximum number of keywords that can be displayed.

7. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to determine a number of keywords in the lower-level lexical cloud based, at least in part, on a size of a display area and a maximum number of keywords that can be displayed.

8. (Original) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to determine a size of each keyword in a lower-level lexical cloud based, at least in part, on the frequency of the keyword in the temporary data structure.

9. (Original) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to select a subset of the plurality of keywords based, at least in part, on a frequency of occurrence of each keyword in the data structure.

10. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to generate the top-level lexical cloud and lower-level lexical clouds in real time in response to user interactions.

11. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to generate a list of items to display based, at least in part, on a size of a display area and keywords selected from the top-level lexical cloud and lower-level lexical clouds.

12. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the memory comprises code configured to direct the processor to generate at least part of the plurality of keywords for the data structure based, at least in part, on a measurement from a sensor and keyword extraction from items in the corpus.

13. (Currently amended) A method for lexical navigation of a corpus of items, comprising: generating a data structure in a non-transitory, computer readable medium, comprising: a plurality of items; a plurality of keywords; and a frequency that each of the plurality of keywords is associated with each of the plurality of items; generating a top-level lexical cloud, wherein the top-level lexical cloud comprises a subset of the plurality of keywords selected based on highest frequency of occurrence, and wherein each keyword in the subset is proportional in size to an overall frequency of occurrence of the keyword in the data structure; receiving a user selection of a particular keyword from the top-level lexical cloud; and generating a lower-level lexical cloud by: eliminating any one of the plurality of items not associated with the selected particular keyword from the data structure; and generating the lower-level lexical cloud as a second subset of the plurality of keywords that remain in the data structure, wherein each keyword in the second subset is proportional in size to an overall frequency of occurrence of the keyword in the data structure after elimination.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, wherein the second subset is chosen by selecting keywords with the highest overall frequency of occurrence in the data structure after elimination of any one of the plurality of items not associated with the selected particular keyword.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, comprising obtaining the plurality of keywords by: obtaining a list of words associated with an item; excluding common words from the list; stemming words to obtain root forms; filtering words based on linguistic criteria; and storing each of the plurality of keywords in the data structure.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, comprising displaying a list of items selected from the plurality of items based, at least in part, upon a user selection of a first keyword from the top level lexical cloud and a user selection of a second keyword from the lower level lexical cloud.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, comprising generating at least part of the plurality of keywords for the data structure based, at least in part, on aesthetic descriptions provided during physical examination of the items and keyword extraction algorithms applied to item metadata.

18. (Currently amended) A non-transitory, computer-readable medium, comprising code configured to direct a processor to: generate a data structure comprising: a plurality of items; a plurality of keywords; and a frequency that each of the plurality of keywords is associated with each of the plurality of items; generate a top-level lexical cloud, comprising a subset of the plurality of keywords selected based on highest frequency of appearance, wherein each keyword in the top-level lexical cloud is sized proportionally to its frequency of appearance in the data structure; receive a user selection of a keyword from the top-level lexical cloud; and generate a lower-level lexical cloud by: creating a temporary data structure by removing any items not associated with the selected keyword from the data structure; and generating the lower-level lexical cloud from the temporary data structure, comprising a second subset of the plurality of keywords, wherein each keyword in the second subset is sized proportionally to its frequency of appearance in the temporary data structure.

19. (Currently amended) The non-transitory, computer-readable medium of claim 18, comprising code configured to direct the processor to display the top-level lexical cloud and obtain a user selection of a keyword from the top-level lexical cloud.

20. (Currently amended) The non-transitory, computer-readable medium of claim 18, comprising code configured to direct the processor to display a subset of the plurality of items based, at least in part, upon a first keyword selected by a user from the top-level lexical cloud and a second keyword selected by a user from the lower-level lexical cloud.
